# About

I am a computational social scientist studying how humans and automated systems decide who deserves what. My research spans _algorithmic fairness_, _crowdfunding and social welfare_, and _political identity and conflict_.

I co-authored [*GoFailMe: The Unfulfilled Promise of Digital Crowdfunding*](book/) (Stanford University Press). I recently developed [FairFund-Bench](news/2026-08-21-publication-fairfund-bench-article.html), a benchmark evaluating distributive bias in LLM allocation decisions (forthcoming in *Findings of EMNLP 2026*). I received my Ph.D. in sociology from the University of Toronto.
